title: Company Overview
content: Established in 2025, VELOURA is an e-commerce fashion brand offering high-quality, expressive, and accessible clothing ranging from timeless wardrobe staples to bold statement pieces focused on comfort, creativity, and self-expression. The brand prioritizes quality assurance through reputable suppliers, secure shopping via data encryption and protected payment channels, and dependable customer service. Official customer support and updates are available through Facebook, Instagram, email at velourabd.online@gmail.com, or phone at 01629743377.

title: Privacy Policy
content: VELOURA collects personal identification information (including name, phone number, email address, browsing history, and purchase details) voluntarily submitted through account registration, order placement, and customer inquiries, alongside non-personal technical data (browser type, operating system, ISP) and browser cookies to personalize navigation and improve customer support responsiveness. While users may browse anonymously or disable cookies, doing so may restrict certain interactive features and services. Collected user credentials and transaction records are protected using secure data storage and strict access controls, with VELOURA explicitly prohibiting the selling, trading, or renting of personal identification data to third parties. Information is only disclosed as anonymized, aggregated demographic data with trusted partners, or shared with vetted third-party service providers (such as payment processors and notification platforms) strictly necessary to fulfill business operations and customer-approved services. Continued use of www.velourabd.com and its associated channels constitutes acceptance of this policy, which VELOURA reserves the right to revise at any time without prior notice.

title: Payment Methods
content: Customers must register with a valid phone number and password to make purchases, bearing sole responsibility for safeguarding login credentials. Standard orders can be paid via Cash on Delivery—collected upon delivery within Khulna or paid to the courier before parcel collection outside Khulna—or through online payment options, including mobile financial services (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, and others), internet banking, and domestic or international credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, AMEX; proof of identity required for international payments). Checkout totals transparently include all delivery charges and VAT with no hidden fees, and all transactions are processed securely through external gateways using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) without storing card information on VELOURA servers (declined payments must be resolved directly with the customer's bank). For SPACES (furniture) items, a mandatory 10% advance payment is required for order confirmation, and deliveries outside Khulna require full balance settlement before dispatch; cancellations for furniture must be submitted to Customer Service within 24 hours for a full refund to the original payment channel, after which the 10% advance deposit becomes non-refundable.

title: Shipping Information
content: Orders are typically processed within 1 to 3 business days from purchase, with fulfillment handled via standard or express shipping depending on the product or service type. Customers are responsible for providing complete, accurate delivery addresses and verifying any geographic or regulatory shipping restrictions, as VELOURA accepts no liability for items delivered incorrectly due to erroneous customer details, and shipments returned due to non-delivery will incur additional shipping fees charged to the customer. Delivery confirmations along with tracking information (where applicable) are sent via email upon fulfillment, while digital purchases are delivered electronically via email or customer accounts. Although regular transit windows are prioritized, external delays caused by weather or customs may occasionally occur; shipping assistance and inquiries can be addressed directly via velourabd.online@gmail.com or 01629743377.

title: Terms and Conditions
content: By using www.velourabd.com, users agree to terms governed by the laws of Bangladesh, wherein VELOURA retains full ownership of platform intellectual property (unauthorized reproduction prohibited) and receives a global, non-exclusive license for any user-submitted content. Items are sold exclusively for personal use (not for resale); minor display variances may occur, and VELOURA reserves the right to correct specifications, stock levels, or pricing errors without prior notice. Final checkout prices are fixed upon placement and include an applicable 7.5% Value Added Tax (VAT). Order cancellations are strictly permitted only during the order confirmation call; once confirmed, orders cannot be canceled until a physical delivery attempt is made. Delivery inside Khulna takes 24–48 hours at a fee of 70 BDT, while delivery outside Khulna takes 24–96 hours at 120 BDT (urgent delivery is unavailable on Fridays and government holidays, and unreachability may lead to cancellation). If a delivery fails, refunds are processed within 14 business days following banking confirmation. Customers must submit an unboxing video to claim replacements or adjustments for incorrect items or mismatched quantities. Orders may be rejected or canceled due to failed identity verification, stock depletion, or suspected fraud (with full refunds for prepaid cancellations), and VELOURA’s maximum legal liability is strictly capped at the purchase price paid for the product.

title: Refund Eligibility
content: To be eligible for a refund, requests must be submitted within 3 days of delivery by contacting customer service at velourabd.online@gmail.com or 01629743377 with the order number and issue details. Items must be unused, undamaged, and returned in their original packaging; items that are used or altered are ineligible. Following internal review and approval, refunds are automatically credited back to the customer's original payment method within 15 days (typically posting within 5 to 7 working days after initiation). If funds have not appeared within that window, customers should first verify with their card issuer or Mobile Financial Service (MFS) provider before reaching out back to customer support. VELOURA reserves the right to update the refund policy at any time without prior notice, with revisions taking effect immediately upon publication.
